newsitem.title: GERMANY: Dancers held in Germany with 50,000 ecstasy pills.
newsitem.headline: Dancers held in Germany with 50,000 ecstasy pills.

text.p: Customs officers detained two American dancers at Duesseldorf airport after finding 50,000 ecstasy tablets worth $400,000 in their rucksacks, a spokesman said on Tuesday.
Customs officers noticed irregularities as they X-rayed the women's luggage, and found six packs of tablets wrapped in layers of carbon paper hidden under false bottoms in the bags.
Customs officials said they suspected a top-level American drugs ring was behind the operation because of the professional way in which the luggage had been prepared.
The two women had acquired the drugs in Amsterdam and were intending to fly back to New York.
Airport authorities declined to give the names of the two women.
The use of ecstasy is illegal but widespread in western Europe among young people at discos and parties.
